Definition: Elale or Elaleh, a place east of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Elale or Elaleh is a place east of the Jordan. The name appears in Numbers and Isaiah. It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elale or Elaleh matters because God's story happened in real places, and Elale or Elaleh is one of them.
RelatedEvents: Reuben and Gad Settle East of the Jordan
